full_judgment: 6. In Writ Petition No. 2091 of 2008 it is stated that the petitioner was appointed in Biman as Store Inspector on 23-6-1983 and last he was serving as store Inspector officer with highest satisfaction of the Biman authority. It is further stated that the petitioner was born on 15-9-1950 and his normal date of retirement from service will be on 14-9-2007 but suddenly he received the impugned order dated 4-2-2007 (Annexure-D to the Writ Petition) informing him that his service was terminated and in lieu of the prior notice period he would be paid the said amount of pay.
